title: Keynote at SynSci - Synergy for Science 2026
excerpt: Di Fu delivered a keynote at the SynSci 2026 satellite session at the University of Glasgow, joining researchers to discuss connections between social cognitive science and AI.

title: Second InterAI Workshop: Human-Centred Embodiment at HRI 2026
excerpt: Di Fu and fellow organisers brought together the HRI community for the second InterAI Workshop, with discussions of embodiment, responsible robotics and flexible human-robot teaming.

title: New Interdisciplinary Principal Fellow Role at PAI
excerpt: Di Fu shared her new role at the Surrey Institute for People-Centred AI (PAI), alongside her position in the School of Psychology, and reflected on the lab’s growth and arrival of Misty Robot.

title: Launching an Interdisciplinary Cognitive Science and AI Conference at Cambridge
excerpt: As organising chair, Di Fu reflected on the inaugural Exploring Interdisciplinary Frontiers conference at Selwyn College, Cambridge, held on 9-10 May 2025 with over 120 participants from 18 countries.

title: Invitation to Take Part in Beyza’s Game Research Study
excerpt: Di Fu shared an invitation to participate in MSc student Beyza’s game research experiment, following her own experience as its first participant. This is an archived recruitment announcement.

title: Beyza Receives the MSc Psychology Research Excellence Prize
excerpt: Di Fu congratulated her MSc dissertation student Beyza Akyıldız-Greenhalgh on receiving the Research Excellence Prize at Surrey’s MSc Psychology Summer Conference 2025.

title: Invited to Speak at the IROS 2025 Workshop on Embodied AI
excerpt: Di Fu announced her invitation to speak at the IROS 2025 workshop on Embodied AI and Robotics for Future Scientific Discovery, scheduled for 24 October in Hangzhou.

title: HRI-Free Research Featured in The Irish Times
excerpt: The lab’s ICRA work on cognitive robotic simulation and social attention was featured in an Irish Times article discussing the future of AGI and human-AI interaction.

title: Face Pareidolia Research Shared by Surrey’s Media Team
excerpt: Di Fu highlighted university media coverage of the team’s new face pareidolia research, published in Perception / i-Perception.

title: CO-HABIT Workshop at IEEE RO-MAN: Final Call for Papers
excerpt: A call shared by co-organiser Doreen Jirak invited work on explainable AI, trust and human-centred interaction for the CO-HABIT Workshop at IEEE RO-MAN 2025. This is an archived call for papers.

title: Presenting HRI-Free and Co-Chairing an HRI Session at ICRA 2025
excerpt: At ICRA in Atlanta, Di Fu presented HRI-Free, co-authored with Fares Abawi, and co-chaired the Perception for Human-Robot Interaction session. The study supports scalable and reproducible evaluation of embodied social attention.

title: Writing for Psychology Today on Humanoid Robots and Everyday Life
excerpt: Di Fu shared her Psychology Today article offering a perspective on humanoid robots, human-robot interaction and their potential role in everyday life.
